training.loss: mean assistant target token loss per example, equal example weighting
training.cuda_cache_policy: release unused cached allocations after each microbatch

round1.sample_order: one seeded permutation of all 320 rows

corrections.acceptance: exact pre-action native save, successful corrective action, observed problem addressed, original-horizon scripted continuation without sustained failure
corrections.mixture: 160 original rows without replacement plus 160 current-round verified corrections with replacement
corrections.insufficient_data: stop incomplete; do not manufacture labels or repeat unchanged-data training

final_evaluation.test_opening_gate: all three selected adapters and experiment sources/settings hashed before any final test

claims: Single-seed, same-geometry maintenance pilot. Training loss and teacher disagreement alone are not gameplay improvement. Preserve worse rounds, timeouts and failed attempts. No custom-kernel training or new whole-model speed claim.
